source: 刘晓燕《四级你还在背单词吗》
title: The Cutter in the Mountain Shed
tts_text: Old Chen had a beard as white as salt and a small shed behind his house. Every morning he would grind a rough stone against the wheel and polish it until it shone. He had lived in this region for forty years and knew its rocks well. He explored the old mine alone, but he was never reckless; he never went in without a lamp. Others came to exploit the mountain for quick money, and he did not. One spring the mine had to be opened again, and workers set a small blast at the far end. The burst of sound came, rock exploded outward, and the shock could tear a coat open. In the broken wall he found a treasure: a clear crystal, the size of a plum. It was precious enough to make his hands shake. He could not estimate its worth, only give an approximate price, and even that was a guess. He reckoned it might pay for a new roof, but selling it in a hurry would devalue it. The ultimate price, he felt, was not money. This crystal had its origin deep in the mountain; such stones originate in heat and pressure. From the same rock he had once derived a small blue one, and the mine never deprived him of work. Few things thrive in this hard region, yet he had thrived and meant to strive. His wife had been gone for years. Their life had been intimate and quiet, and he kept a record of every stone he cut. He did not regard the crystal as property but as a guest. His work did not accord with fashion, and he did not care.

sentences_cn: 老陈的胡子白得像盐，屋后有一间小小的棚屋。
每天早上，他都要把一块粗石贴到砂轮上磨，一直抛光到发亮。
他在这个地区住了四十年，对这里的石头了如指掌。
他喜欢一个人去探那座老矿，但他从不莽撞；没有灯，他绝不进去。
别人是来开采这座山、赚快钱的，他不是。
有一年春天，矿又要重新打开，工人们在最里头放了一小炮。
爆响传来，岩石向外炸开，那股冲击力能把一件外套撕开。
在裂开的岩壁里，他找到了一件宝贝：一块李子大小的透明水晶。
它珍贵得让他的手都抖了起来。
他估不出它的价值，只能给一个大概的价钱，而那也只是猜的。
他估算这够换一个新屋顶，但急着卖出去只会让它贬值。
他觉得，最终的价格不在钱上。
这块水晶的源头在山的深处；这类石头是在高温和压力中生成的。
同一块岩石里，他还曾开出过一小块蓝色的，而这座矿从没让他没活干。
在这片贫瘠的地方，很少有东西能长得兴旺，可他却兴旺起来了，还打算一直奋斗下去。
他的妻子已经走了很多年。
他们的日子曾经亲密而安静，他把自己切过的每一块石头都记在本子上。
他不把这块水晶当成财产，而当成一位客人。
他的手艺跟时髦并不合拍，他也不在乎。
